meta.parties: Fernando Et Al v. Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: For an estoppel by acquiescence to be established, the plaintiffs must have known of their rights and stood by while misleading the defendants.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is essential, in order to create an estoppel by acquiescence, to show that the plaintiffs, knowing that a violation of their rights was in progress, stood by and so misled the first and second defendants."
